notes: Iteration-6 check of the iteration-5 fixes (cb43279..a85ec63). X-401 is fixed. Core [Unreleased] 'Changed (BREAKING)' now has the 'DefaultScopeResolver reads tenant_id / tenantId as membership' entry with a before/after table, the approval-option change, and an upgrade note on binding a custom ScopeResolver. The M-301 Fixed entry points to it. The table matches DefaultScopeResolver::resolveUser (lines 105-145) for the default tenancy_required=false config. Changelog and docs discipline for the other fix commits is sound. L-401 and L-402 have accurate core Fixed entries, and FailureReporter::APPROVER_SCOPE_FAILED is additive. The M-401 AI Added entry, README config rows, config docblocks, user-guide claim_ttl paragraph and the DeadlineAwareLlmClient contract docblock all describe the same model (per-request cap = time left minus 2s, refuse under MIN_REQUEST_SECONDS=10). No stale requestTimeoutSeconds() or 'one more timeout' wording is left in packages/ or docs/. Removing requestTimeoutSeconds() is not a break because the contract is new in the same [Unreleased]. C-401 has an accurate CLI [Unreleased] Security entry. Gates on the audit tree: Pint --test passes, PHPStan reports no errors, gofmt -l is empty, report_inventory_gaps --fail-on-gaps finds no gaps, tools/tests pass and scripts/lib/test-release.sh passes 55/55. .github/, scripts/, tools/, composer.json, phpstan.neon, pint.json and the root docs are unchanged since iteration 5, which verified CI, split, release and Dependabot. Dependency direction is unchanged: the new src code is package-local and no new cross-package imports were added. Split readiness is unchanged. Not raised: CLI docs/user-guide.md:460 and docs/agents.md:77 do not list 'name/id not one path segment' as an exit-2 cause. The CHANGELOG covers it and the documented remedy (fix input) still applies, so this is too minor for a loop-stopping pass. FOR CORE AUDITOR / SYNTHESIZER (package-internal, outside cross-cutting scope, not deduped here): the L-401 fix at packages/laravel-capabilities/src/Registry/CapabilityRegistry.php:773 passes 'scope' => new CapabilityScope(tenantId: $tenantId). ResolveTenantFromCaller.php:34-35 returns an explicit scope as-is, so approved executions of tenanted rows now run with teamId/organizationId = null. DefaultScopeResolver.php:172-177 fills those from current_team_id / current_organization_id or the team_id / organization_id options, and a host resolver may fill them too. Before L-401, an approved run got the requester's team and org. Verify whether that is an intended narrowing or a regression.
